notes: Machine 0 ran first, as a smoke test of the same script, before it read the CPU's family and model; its cpu_id is missing.
Containers ran concurrently, at most four at once; Modal placed them in five regions. Two containers on one host cannot be ruled out; no GPU UUID repeated.
The benchmark client ran in the same container as the server, so no network is in the numbers. A campaign measured from elsewhere adds its network path, which can differ per server.
One model (Qwen3-8B BF16), one runtime (vLLM 0.22.1), one workload shape, one GPU model on one provider. Other GPUs, providers and setups are not measured.
